quality_metrics = spark.sql("""
  SELECT current_date() AS check_date, COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
         SUM(CASE WHEN fare_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_fare_count
  FROM bronze.trips WHERE _ingested_at >= current_date()
""")
quality_metrics.write.format("delta").mode("append").saveAsTable("gold.data_quality_metrics")
caption: A genuine small gold table -- a spike here is an early warning worth investigating.
